dialogues.speaker: Dingonek
dialogues.text: (The Saurian resting here looks lost in thought.)

dialogues.speaker: Dingonek
dialogues.text: Or maybe they aren't? The older fellow looks to be in good enough spirits, but the younger one seems downcast.

dialogues.speaker: Dingonek
dialogues.text: Really, I've never seen such passionless conversation. No wonder they can't reach any conclusion.

dialogues.speaker: Dingonek
dialogues.text: Without the slightest passion, not even the strongest of Saurians can fly!
